name: Infuse Holy (or Unholy) Symbol
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target your holy (or unholy) symbol
Duration 5 rounds
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Your holy (or unholy) symbol is temporarily infused with even more divine power than usual. For the duration of the spell, all channel energy attempts are at maximized healing (or damage), and any spells that require a divine focus as a component are cast as if you were one caster level higher.
